title: Cloudflare preflight accepts smoke artifacts missing two current staging checks
reasoning: The staging smoke runner and its test define 10 checks, including professor search and feedback submission. The Cloudflare preflight allowlist only requires 8 checks, and its own test proves an artifact containing only those 8 names is accepted. A stale or hand-written smoke artifact can therefore let cloudflare:preflight pass even when instructor-filter search or feedback ingestion was never exercised.
reproduction: Pass checkSmokeResultsText a JSON array containing only the 8 names from REQUIRED_SMOKE_CHECKS with ok:true; it returns ok even though the current staging smoke test expects professor search route and feedback public route too.
recommendation: Add the missing smoke names to REQUIRED_SMOKE_CHECKS or export a shared list from staging-smoke.ts so preflight validates the same checks that test:staging produces.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The staging-smoke test verifies the runner emits 10 checks, but the cloudflare preflight test constructs an 8-check artifact and expects it to pass; there is no test that preflight rejects an artifact missing professor search route or feedback public route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Update the preflight test to build its valid artifact from the full staging smoke check list, then assert removing professor search route or feedback public route makes checkSmokeResultsText fail.
minimumFixScope: scripts/cloudflare-staging-preflight.ts REQUIRED_SMOKE_CHECKS and its unit test fixture.
